segments.name: trivago
segments.description: Runs hotel metasearch sites and earns referral advertising revenue.
segments.evidence: Our trivago segment generates advertising revenue primarily from sending referrals to online travel companies and travel service providers from its hotel metasearch websites.

revenueModel.text: Travellers pay for bookings and travel suppliers pay for referrals and advertising.
revenueModel.evidence: Our B2C segment provides a full range of travel and advertising services to our worldwide customers through recognized consumer brands that target a variety of customer segments and geographic regions with tailored offerings.
